⁣🔥 𝐂𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐃𝐚𝐭𝐚 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐞𝐰𝐬? 𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐜𝐚𝐧’𝐭 𝐢𝐠𝐧𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐀𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐤.⁣
⁣
If you’re aiming for top roles in data engineering, Spark is a must-know.⁣
⁣
Here’s a powerful checklist of commonly asked Apache Spark interview questions that’ll help you stay ahead:⁣
⁣
🔹 How does Spark work under the hood? Walk through its architecture.⁣
🔹 Where exactly did you apply Spark in your past projects?⁣
🔹 What are some key Spark optimization strategies you used?⁣
🔹 What are transformations vs actions in Spark? Examples?⁣
🔹 When does shuffle happen and how do you handle it?⁣
🔹 GroupByKey vs ReduceByKey — which one and why?⁣
🔹 What are some Spark-related issues you troubleshooted?⁣
⁣
And it doesn’t stop there...⁣
⁣
🚀 More concepts you must prepare:⁣
⁣
Spark vs MapReduce — real-world differences⁣
⁣
Narrow vs Wide transformations — impact on performance⁣
⁣
Partitions — how does Spark manage them?⁣
⁣
RDDs — what are they and when to use them⁣
⁣
Broadcast variables — when and why?⁣
⁣
SparkContext vs SparkSession — do you know the difference?⁣
⁣
Memory management in Spark executors⁣
⁣
DAGs, Lineage Graphs, Catalyst Optimizer — explain them like you teach⁣
⁣
Why Parquet is Spark’s favorite file format⁣
⁣
Overview of Spark Streaming and DStreams⁣
⁣
Key libraries in the Spark ecosystem⁣
⁣
⁣
✅ If you can answer these confidently, you’re already in the top 10%.⁣
⁣
Use this list to guide your prep, revise what matters, and focus your time on high-impact topics.⁣
⁣
Found this helpful? Repost it! 🔁⁣⁣⁣⁣⁣⁣⁣⁣⁣⁣⁣⁣
Follow Akash AB for more insights on Data⁣ Engineering ✅⁣⁣
